title: AI video translation pipeline
logline: One video, posted in every market a seller sells in

rows: Problem
High-performing videos don't carry over to other markets. One-click cross-posts of the original video earned ~50% less revenue than an average post
Insight
In-house models already translate speech, clone the voice and sync lips

parts.s: Translation is the cheapest per quality point, and it starts from a video that already sells

items.name: Translate + lip-sync: Pinch
items.note: Chosen: best value + video already sells

ui: Let us translate your best videos and post them to your other EU markets
Only markets you tick get posts

rows: ✗ GPU waste
Translating our own output, or translating a video into markets with the same language
✓ Mark
Mark videos as AI-translated. Filter them out in the warehouse tables and ETL
✓ Clone
Reuse videos for markets with the same language
Constraint
AI platform has limited resources shared across teams
Decision
Limit sellers to 3 translations a day, so large sellers can't use up the shared budget
Backfill
Backfill runs in an off-peak window to reduce GPU contention

parts.t: Fan-out: parent / child tasks and partial success
rows: Shape
1 source : N target videos. Compute parent status from children
✗ Prevent partial
Succeed and fail together
✓ Allow partial
Successful tasks proceed, failed tasks retry
Failure handling
Retry failed tasks up to 3 times, then send them to the DLQ

parts.t: Scheduled posting: review window and throttled release
rows: Videos post T+2 after translation
→ Sellers can cancel bad translations before they go live, and their quality feedback helps us improve the system
The scheduler polls for due videos in throttled batches of up to 50
→ Spreads load on the DB and downstream services
Scheduled post time, queue and throttle limits are dynamic config
→ We can tune them without a deploy
Method
Calculate average GMV of treatment against control. Random Seller A/B: 15% treatment vs 15% control (Aug - Oct)
Result
+8% average seller revenue
Reliability
~95% of translated videos posted. Sellers kept them through the review window
Blind spot
Posted videos flowed back into our candidate pool and got translated again. An AI-origin flag fixed it. Now I ask of every output: can this come back as input?
Metrics
I launched with technical metrics but no business metrics, and only added those after release. Next time I'd define both before launch
